title: Severe Fuel Shortage Ahead? Pakistan Seeks $10 Billion Loan! 423 Billion Loan To China
description:
In this episode of Shafy's weekly, we cover various news relating to economy of Pakistan and the Stock Market of Pakistan.

Ghandhara Tyre and Rubber Company Limited (PSX:GTYR)  has obtained DOT (Department of Transportation) certification, enabling the company to export tyres to the United States.

Warning of a potential shortage of petroleum products, the country’s oil industry has urged the government to immediately release outstanding Price Differential Claims (PDC) amounting to Rs66.7 billion to ensure an uninterrupted fuel supply. The current supply position is extremely tight, with around 370,000 tonnes of MS stocks — equivalent to approximately 15 days of cover — available nationwide.

The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (Ogra) and the Oil Companies Advisory Council (OCAC) on Thursday alerted the government to possible hoarding of petroleum products across parts of the country, amid expectations of a potential increase in prices. 

Pakistan approves daily petroleum pricing; OGRA to publish fuel rates every day.

Pakistan has sought a $6.7 billion concessional oil financing facility from Saudi Arabia for a period of 15 years. The sources said Pakistan was actively seeking the $6.7 billion Saudi facility at 1% interest rate for a period of 15 years.  Pakistan has sought a five-year grace period and a total 15 years for the repayments of the debt, they added.

The government is looking to secure $10 billion from bilateral creditors at 1% interest rate to retire the expensive Chinese loans. The developments are taking place against the background of China's persistent reluctance to renegotiate its energy contracts that the government wanted to reopen to reduce tariffs.

Cooking oil manufacturer Agro Processors & Atmospheric Gases Ltd is planning an initial public offering in Pakistan this month to finance a plant expansion.

The Privatisation Commission (PC) has taken the first major step towards the privatisation of the State Life Insurance Corporation of Pakistan (SLIC) by inviting technical and financial proposals for the provision of financial advisory services for the transaction.

With the government yet to announce the Auto Policy 2026-31 following the expiry of the 2021-26 policy on June 30 this year, local assemblers have started raising prices of electrified vehicles after the increase in general sales tax (GST) on hybrid vehicles to 25 per cent from 8.5pc in the budget for FY27.

Income Tax Return 2026 is now live on IRIS. You can save your return as a draft, submission not allowed yet.

The SBP said its foreign exchange reserves declined to $17.226 billion as of July 10, compared with $18.471 billion a week earlier. 
Meanwhile, the country’s total liquid foreign exchange reserves stood at $22.676 billion, comprising $17.226 billion held by the central bank and $5.450 billion maintained by commercial banks. 

Trade deficit hits decade-high $39.4b
Over the past decade, exports grew by a mere 37.4%, up from $21.9 billion in FY2016 to $30.1 billion in FY2026. In the same period, imports surged 69.1% to reach $69.5 billion, causing the trade gap to balloon by 105.2% – the worst performance in ten years. 

FY26 IT exports rise to over USD4.5bn
Pakistan’s IT exports has increased from USD3.475 billion in the previous fiscal year, maintaining uninterrupted growth throughout FY26.

The federal government plans to begin privatising Faisalabad Electric Supply Company, Gujranwala Electric Power Company and Islamabad Electric Supply Company in the final quarter of 2026 after completing the shortlisting of prospective bidders 
Hyderabad Electric Supply Corporation and Sukkur Electric Supply Corporation would be taken up in the next phase. 
government prioritises DISCOs with transmission and distribution losses of around 9-10% 

The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) on Tuesday barred Inland Revenue Officers from entering the premises of small shops and retailers, who would display FBR’s shopkeeper plate (“Green Plate”) at their shops across the country.

title: PSX vs US Stocks: Which Market Can Build More Wealth?
description:
👉 Advisory services: https://arnfinancials.com/financial-advisory-service/  
👉 Register for ARN Financial’s Investing Masterclass now: https://arnfinancials.com/masterclass/  
👉 Arrange a call back from our team: https://arnfinancials.com/financialfreedom/

Should Pakistanis invest in the Pakistan Stock Exchange or international markets such as the US stock market? And can a monthly SIP still create real wealth after inflation?

In this Monthly Investor Q&A, Abdul Rehman Najam compares the long-term performance of PSX with the S&P 500, Nasdaq and FTSE 100 including the impact of PKR depreciation and dollar-adjusted returns. The discussion also covers stock-market volatility, inflation-adjusted SIP calculations, investing for overseas Pakistanis, upper-lock rallies in small-cap stocks, foreign-exchange reserves, and whether investors should continue holding or investing once a company reaches its estimated fair value.

Company-specific questions include Ghani Chemical Industries (PSX: GCIL), Ghandhara Automobiles (PSX: GAL), JAC T9 Hunter and the potential effect of new projects, changing sales volumes and future earnings.

What we answered in this QnA:

- PSX vs US and international stock markets
- Historical returns in PKR and US dollar terms
- Investing options for overseas Pakistanis
- Can a monthly SIP beat inflation?
- Inflation-adjusted 10, 15 and 20-year calculations
- Risks of chasing upper-lock rallies
- Small-cap investing and portfolio allocation
- GCIL projects and potential earnings impact
- Ghandhara Automobiles and JAC T9 analysis
- Foreign-exchange reserves and market cycles
- SIP versus lump-sum investing
- What to do when a stock reaches fair value

Recent geopolitical developments including US-Iran tensions and regional conflicts also follow predictable frameworks based on historical patterns, oil price impacts, and presidential records on war duration.

Systems-based investing addresses the psychological challenge of market movements. When analysis frameworks replace emotional reactions, anxiety decreases significantly. Financial literacy directly connects to anxiety reduction understanding what indicators actually matter separates temporary disruptions from genuine structural changes.
